decisionRows.buyerQuestion: Is paper-based packaging always more sustainable?
decisionRows.practicalAnswer: No. Buyers should review structure, material source, coating, decoration, durability, shipping damage risk and local recycling acceptance together.
decisionRows.mugeFit: Use for paper boxes, rigid gift boxes, paper tubes and corrugated packaging when the product can be protected without overbuilding the pack.
decisionRows.caution: Do not claim a material is recyclable or compliant in every market without project-specific document review.

decisionRows.buyerQuestion: When should a brand consider paper tube packaging?
decisionRows.practicalAnswer: Paper tubes are useful when cylindrical presentation, shelf impact, gift feel or product protection around a bottle, jar, candle or small retail item matters.
decisionRows.mugeFit: MUGE can review diameter, height, cap structure, material, printing and finish options for custom paper tube projects.
decisionRows.caution: Food-contact or cosmetic-contact requirements need separate document review before any claim is made.

decisionRows.buyerQuestion: What makes sustainable packaging more expensive?
decisionRows.practicalAnswer: Cost can change with board grade, recycled content, coating choice, structure complexity, finish, inserts, testing needs, order quantity and logistics.
decisionRows.mugeFit: Use an engineering brief to compare structure options before requesting sampling or quotation.
decisionRows.caution: Do not publish fixed price or MOQ without confirmed project specs.

decisionRows.buyerQuestion: How should EU or North American buyers compare suppliers?
decisionRows.practicalAnswer: Ask for material options, artwork review process, structure drawings, sample review steps and documents available for the exact project.
decisionRows.mugeFit: MUGE supports project review for custom paper boxes, rigid boxes, paper tubes, PVC/PET clear boxes and corrugated packaging.
decisionRows.caution: Supplier claims should be matched to actual certificates, document scope and target market requirements.

safetyBoundary: No unsupported certification, MOQ, lead time, capacity, customer case, food-contact, FDA/FSC or lowest-price claim is made.
